worst_flaw: The learning design is a single before-and-after comparison with no comparison crews or plain-support arm, so any rise above 35% cannot be credited to the meal reward rather than the offline fixes, paid practice or prefilled workflow. On top of that, the 80% crew threshold that applies only in weeks 5 and 6 is not tied to the 35% baseline, which makes the reward an all-or-nothing group stake that could push crews to pressure each other.
